FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 112
Committee: Finance and Taxation General Fund Sponsor: Senator Greg Albritton
Analyst: JT Mathis Date: 04/04/2023
Senate Bill 112 as introduced would require the Alabama Department of Environment
Management (ADEM) to assess a monthly environmental fee of $0.85 per customer of a
community water system for the purpose of covering the costs associated with assuring water
quality and the administration of environment programs.
In addition, this bill would increase the administrative obligations of the Department of Revenue
(DOR) by an undetermined amount to adopt rules for the implementation and administration of
this bill, and for the administration of the collection of fees received by community water system
operators which would be offset partly by DOR's administrative collection allowance.
Based on the number of community water system customers reported by ADEM, the estimated
increase in fee receipts to the Alabama Department of Environmental Management Fund less
the DOR administrative collection allowance, would be approximately $17.1 million in fiscal
year 2025 and $18.7 million every fiscal year thereafter.
